correctness.rationale: Independent exact reconstruction from the actual frozen eight-file Git tree and its 60 explicit 5-vertex facets gives f=(12,66,144,150,60). Contracting 11 star edges produces a free graph-cycle lattice of rank 55; an independently constructed 144x55 integer boundary matrix has Smith normal form diag(1^54,0), proving H1(K;Z)=Z without torsion. The source explicit cocycle is independently checked on every one of 144 face boundaries, maps cycle (1,2,3) to -1 and gives +1 on 30 and -1 on 46 of all 76 missing three-vertex cliques; all therefore primitive H1 generators and all shortest simple nonzero integral-homology cycles. An independent exhaustive backtracking algorithm prunes only on preserved triangular membership, verifies every candidate on all 60 facets, finds exactly 96 simplicial automorphisms, and computes carrier orbits 12,48,16 with representatives (123),(126),(148) and H1 sign actions 48/48. Actual eight original Git blob identifiers reconstruct the assigned tree SHA. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for this fixed 12-vertex complex, not extrapolated.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact combinatorial one-systole carrier classification for the natural small, maximally neighborly, vertex-transitive 12-vertex triangulation of a twisted S3-bundle over S1, not an arbitrary invariant chosen after computation. The entire first possible simple-loop layer consists of the 76 missing triangular faces, and identifying their nontrivial primitive integral H1 classes, three full symmetry orbits and both induced H1 signs provides information not mechanically implied by the published manifold homology, face vector or group order. Its motivation is shortest nontrivial simplicial loops and symmetry type, a natural exact invariant of this fully specified triangulated manifold; no general theorem or global census is claimed.

limitations: Scope is fixed labelled simplicial triangulation and simple edge-cycle length, not a geodesic metric systole or a universal twisted-bundle classification.
Signs of 30 versus 46 oriented triangle evaluations use increasing vertex labels and are not intrinsic.
